answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7063 Country: India Title: When we pray namaaz behind the imaam do we recite anything? e.g. eshah sallah 3rd and 4th rakaat, do we have to recite surah fatiha. Question: When we pray namaaz behind the imaam do we recite anything? e.g. eshah sallah 3rd and 4th rakaat, do we have to recite surah fatiha. Answer ID: 7063 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 779/779=M/1429) When you perform salah behind an Imam, you should never recite Surah Fatiha or any other Surah whether it is the third or forth rakah of Isha salah or any salah . One is stopped to recite behind an Imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
